## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, meeting the Sector Weakness threshold; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Risk and Cycle signals are N/A; weak breadth and losses in Technology and Financials confirm a mixed, non-directional backdrop. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads on the week: TJX (1W: +10.79% | 1M: +0.46%) ABOVE TREND and F (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +4.45%) ABOVE TREND. Communication follows with TTWO (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples is also positive, led by TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy is weakest: MPC (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -24.33%) BELOW TREND and VLO (1W: -10.42% | 1M: -23.64%) BELOW TREND. Technology is also weak, with AVGO (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND and AMD (1W: -17.91% | 1M: -22.21%) BELOW TREND; Materials trails with FCX (1W: -13.69% | 1M: -26.75%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW (1W: +14.13% | 1M: -9.60%) RECOVERY; TJX (1W: +10.79% | 1M: +0.46%) ABOVE TREND; TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND; TTWO (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND; F (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +4.45%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); PANW’s short-term surge diverges from its monthly decline.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMD (1W: -17.91% | 1M: -22.21%) BELOW TREND; FCX (1W: -13.69% | 1M: -26.75%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -12.90% | 1M: -17.79%) BELOW TREND; TXN (1W: -12.65% | 1M: -12.89%) BELOW TREND; UNH (1W: -12.27% | 1M: -16.76%) BELOW TREND. Weakness spans Technology, Materials, and Healthcare.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: PANW (1W: +14.13% | 1M: -9.60%) RECOVERY, TJX (1W: +10.79% | 1M: +0.46%) ABOVE TREND, and TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND. PANW is a short-term bounce, not a confirmed trend change; watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with the sector down 3.37% on the week and 15.55% over the month; constituent breadth counts were not provided. NVDA (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -28.06%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -6.67%) BELOW TREND, and GOOGL (1W: -0.41% | 1M: -11.92%) BELOW TREND show persistent pressure.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak on aggregate: Financials returned -2.36% for the week and -1.74% for the month; constituent breadth counts were not provided. JPM (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -5.07%) BELOW TREND contrasts with MA (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND; V (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +3.31%) is NEUTRAL.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed: Healthcare declined 0.62% on the week but remains up 0.69% over the month; constituent breadth counts were not provided. GILD (1W: +4.72% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND and AMGN (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +7.21%) ABOVE TREND contrast with UNH (1W: -12.27% | 1M: -16.76%) BELOW TREND; LLY (1W: -0.56% | 1M: +10.18%) is in CORRECTION.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay selective in a NEUTRAL regime: favor relative strength in Consumer Discretionary, Communication, and Consumer Staples, while monitoring weakness in Technology, Energy, and Financials. Style is mixed / no clear leadership; broad Top 5 sector representation is constructive, but only 3/11 sectors are positive.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND and GILD (1W: +4.72% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND, conditional on continued follow-through. BEARISH: AMD (1W: -17.91% | 1M: -22.21%) BELOW TREND and UNH (1W: -12.27% | 1M: -16.76%) BELOW TREND remain at risk if weakness persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (+1.60% 1W, +4.39% 1M) and Communication (+1.48% 1W, +9.26% 1M) lead; overall breadth remains only 3/11 positive. BEARISH: Energy (-5.67% 1W, -14.56% 1M) and Technology (-3.37% 1W, -15.55% 1M) show the clearest weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price levels were not supplied; use return-based triggers rather than fabricated price targets. Monitor whether PANW (1W: +14.13% | 1M: -9.60%) RECOVERY holds its weekly advance, and whether AMD (1W: -17.91% | 1M: -22.21%) BELOW TREND and JPM (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -5.07%) BELOW TREND stabilize.

GILD (+45): positive coverage initiation; GILD (1W: +4.72% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?

AMD (-35): AI-spending concerns; AMD (1W: -17.91% | 1M: -22.21%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. MSFT (-35): global service outage; MSFT (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -6.67%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime: Breadth is 3/11 sectors positive, with Sector Weakness and Broad leadership (4 sectors in Top 5); style is mixed / no clear leadership. TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND and TTWO (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength. Monitor weak Technology breadth and the divergence in PANW (1W: +14.13% | 1M: -9.60%) RECOVERY; its sharp weekly rise has not reversed the monthly decline.
